purpose: Mood, composition, lighting, and UI-feel target for A Corpse in Good Standing.
must_keep: Corvin reads primarily from side profile
amber equals alive and green equals wrong
bottom verb and inventory UI remains compact
known_issues: Corvin is slightly three-quarter rather than strict side profile
UI text is mockup quality only
hotspot labels are illustrative and not authoritative
palette must still be audited through G9 and G10
final assets must still come through Meshy, Blender, paintover, and Godot layer separation
pipeline_contract: Use Meshy only for helper geometry and character source models.
Use Blender blockouts and ink-wash passes for deterministic source renders.
Use paintover for final 2D room plates.
Keep props and hotspots as separate runtime layers when state can change.
Do not import this mockup as final art.
